en: The best way out is always through.
zh: 最好的出路，永远是穿过去。
author: Robert Frost

en: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
zh: 不怕慢，只怕站；只要不停下，就一直在前进。
author: Confucius

en: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
zh: 几乎所有东西，断电歇几分钟都会好起来——包括你。
author: Anne Lamott

en: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
zh: 用你拥有的，在你所在的，做你能做的。
author: Theodore Roosevelt

en: Not all those who wander are lost.
zh: 并非所有徘徊的人都迷失了方向。
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

en: Each day provides its own gifts.
zh: 每一天都带着属于它自己的礼物。
author: Marcus Aurelius

en: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
zh: 领先的秘密，就是先开始。
author: Mark Twain

en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu

zh: 休息不是无所事事，而是为了更好地出发。
author: John Lubbock

en: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
zh: 不必等很厉害才开始，开始了才会变得很厉害。
author: Zig Ziglar

en: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
zh: 跌倒七次，第八次也要站起来。
author: Japanese Proverb

en: Nothing is impossible. The word itself says "I'm possible"!
zh: 没有不可能——这个词本身就在说「我可能」。
author: Audrey Hepburn
